#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
# 创建 5 个模拟主机目录(h1..h5),各含 etc/os-release、etc/sshd_config、var/lib/myapp/state.json
for h in h1 h2 h3 h4 h5; do
  mkdir -p "hosts/$h/etc" "hosts/$h/var/lib/myapp"
done
# h1/h2/h4/h5:Ubuntu 24.04 + 默认 sshd 端口 22 + 允许密码
for h in h1 h2 h4 h5; do
  cat > "hosts/$h/etc/os-release" <<'EOF'
NAME="Ubuntu"
VERSION="24.04 (Noble Numbat)"
ID=ubuntu
EOF
  cat > "hosts/$h/etc/sshd_config" <<'EOF'
Port 22
PermitRootLogin no
PasswordAuthentication yes
PubkeyAuthentication yes
EOF
  printf '{"app_version":"1.2.3","last_run":"2026-09-11","state":"healthy"}' > "hosts/$h/var/lib/myapp/state.json"
done
# h3 故意不同:Port 2222 + PasswordAuthentication no + 不同 OS + 不同 state.json
cat > "hosts/h3/etc/os-release" <<'EOF'
NAME="Debian"
VERSION="12 (Bookworm)"
ID=debian
EOF
cat > "hosts/h3/etc/sshd_config" <<'EOF'
Port 2222
PermitRootLogin no
PasswordAuthentication no
PubkeyAuthentication yes
EOF
printf '{"app_version":"1.2.4","last_run":"2026-09-10","state":"degraded"}' > "hosts/h3/var/lib/myapp/state.json"
mkdir -p last_snapshot
echo DJ06_FLEET_GEN_OK hosts=5

args.command: cd tmpPlan/agent-test/dj06 && bash gen_local_fleet.sh && ls hosts/h1/etc/ && ls hosts/h3/etc/ && test -f hosts/h3/etc/os-release && echo DJ06_Q1_OK

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# fleet_inspect.sh:并发遍历 hosts/{h1..h5}/ 收集指纹 → JSON 行输出(current.jsonl)
# 用法:bash fleet_inspect.sh [hosts_dir=hosts] [out=current.jsonl]
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
hosts_dir="${1:-hosts}"
out="${2:-current.jsonl}"
collect() {
  local h="$1"
  local etc="$hosts_dir/$h/etc"
  local lib="$hosts_dir/$h/var/lib/myapp"
  local os_ver
  os_ver=$(grep '^VERSION=' "$etc/os-release" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/VERSION=//' | tr -d '"')
  local ssh_port
  ssh_port=$(grep '^Port ' "$etc/sshd_config" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | awk '{print $2}')
  local ssh_pw
  ssh_pw=$(grep '^PasswordAuthentication ' "$etc/sshd_config" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | awk '{print $2}')
  local sshd_hash
  sshd_hash=$(sha256sum "$etc/sshd_config" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | head -c 16)
  local state_hash
  state_hash=$(cat "$lib/state.json" 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}' | head -c 16)
  printf '{"host":"%s","os":"%s","ssh_port":%s,"ssh_pw_auth":"%s","sshd_hash":"%s","state_hash":"%s"}\n' \
    "$h" "$os_ver" "${ssh_port:-0}" "${ssh_pw:-?}" "$sshd_hash" "$state_hash"
}
export -f collect
export hosts_dir
ls "$hosts_dir" | sort | xargs -P 5 -I{} bash -c 'collect "$@"' _ {} > "$out"
echo "DJ06_INSPECT_OK $(wc -l < "$out")"

args.command: cd tmpPlan/agent-test/dj06 && bash fleet_inspect.sh hosts current.jsonl && cp current.jsonl last_snapshot/snapshot_v1.jsonl && echo '--- 模拟 h3 sshd_config 变更 ---' && sed -i 's/PasswordAuthentication no/PasswordAuthentication yes/' hosts/h3/etc/sshd_config && bash fleet_inspect.sh hosts current.jsonl && diff -u last_snapshot/snapshot_v1.jsonl current.jsonl > drift_report.txt 2>&1 || true && echo '--- drift_report.txt ---' && cat drift_report.txt && grep -q h3 drift_report.txt && echo DJ06_Q3_OK

args.content:
# DJ06 本地多目录批量巡检(offline fleet)报告

## 一、ssh -o BatchMode=yes 避免交互卡死

批量 SSH 巡检时,默认 ssh 行为在遇到:
- 首次连接新主机(yes/no 交互)
- known_hosts 变更(交互询问)
- 公钥认证失败(询问密码)
都会**阻塞等待 stdin**,导致 `xargs -P` 并发巡检中只要任何一台主机出现上述情况,整个批次卡死。

`ssh -o BatchMode=yes` 强制 ssh 永不交互:
- 新主机直接 fail(不询问 yes/no)
- known_hosts 冲突直接 fail(不更新)
- 密码认证直接 fail(不询问密码)

本任务未涉及真实 SSH,但 fleet_inspect.sh 的离线模拟演示了同样语义——所有交互分支必须失败而非阻塞。

## 二、xargs -P 并发原理

`xargs -P 5 -I{} bash -c 'cmd "$@"' _ {}` 含义:
- `-P 5`:最多 5 个进程并发
- `-I{}`:每个 stdin 输入替换为 `{}` 占位符
- `bash -c 'collect "$@"' _ {}`:`_` 占位 `$0`(脚本名),`{}` 作为 `$1` 传入
- 进程满 5 时新输入排队,任一进程完成立即接手下一个

5 主机并发 vs 串行时间对比(每主机 100ms):
- 串行:5 × 100ms = 500ms
- 5 并发:max(100ms) = 100ms

并发数选择:通常 = CPU 核心数(纯计算)或 IO 等待数(网络巡检可设更高,如 -P 20)。

## 三、本地多目录巡检是真实批量巡检的离线等价物

真实生产 SSH fleet 巡检代码:
```bash
hosts=(h1 h2 h3 h4 h5)
printf '%s\n' "${hosts[@]}" | xargs -P 5 -I{} ssh -o BatchMode=yes \
  user@{} "sha256sum /etc/sshd_config /var/lib/myapp/state.json"
```

本任务用 `hosts/h{1..5}/etc/...` 目录结构替代 `user@h{1..5}:/etc/...`:
- **数据拓扑一致**:同样 5 主机 × 3 配置文件的二维矩阵
- **API 一致**:同样 `cat` / `sha256sum` / `grep` 命令,只是路径前缀从 `ssh://user@h:/etc` 变 `hosts/h/etc`
- **并发模型一致**:同样用 `xargs -P` 触发并行
- **漂移检测一致**:同样用 `diff snapshot current` 输出差异报告

唯一差异:**真实 SSH 的网络延迟与失败注入**(timeout/refused/host-unknown)被本地文件系统的「确定性存在」取代。

收益:
- e2e 测试无需真实 SSH server,可重复运行
- 不污染生产环境,失败可恢复
- 本地跑通的脚本加 `ssh user@h` 后通常直接可用

## 四、本次产物清单

- gen_local_fleet.sh:5 主机目录生成器
- fleet_inspect.sh:并发指纹采集器(JSONL)
- current.jsonl:巡检产物(5 行 JSON)
- last_snapshot/snapshot_v1.jsonl:baseline
- drift_report.txt:h3 sshd_config 漂移报告
- dj06_report.md:本文件
